content: {{snippet.Caching2_and_EventGrp_Warning}} {{variable.Object_Event}} s that are similar can be shown on the same list by assigning them to an {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} . For example, if you want to group webinars together, you can create a new {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} record named Webinars in Salesforce and it will group your webinars together. Keep reading to find out more! Event Group Capacity Cache 2.0: The Events app supports a maximum of 1000 Event Groups with 2000 Events per Event Group. Pre-Cache 2.0: The Events app supports a maximum of 1000 Event Groups with 250 Events per Event Group. You can reduce the size of your Event Groups by splitting your Event Groups, unpublishing past Events, or removing Events from an Event Group. Look and Feel With {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} s, there are currently four different UIs that are supported. Check them out below to see which you like the most! Here is an example of the {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} List view. Here is an example of the {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} Calendar view. Here is an example of the {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} Aspen view. Here is an example of the {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} Maple view. Thumbnail Images If an {{variable.Object_Event}} uses the Dynamic UI, and the {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s image distorts when viewing the {{variable.Object_Event}} in an {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} , add a “thumbnail” image to the {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s {{variable.Field_EV_ThumbnailMobiImageURL}} (conference360__Thumbnail_and_Mobile_Image_URL__c) field. The recommended aspect ratio is 2:1. Now, when a user views the {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} webpage on a desktop or mobile device, the {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s image will no longer be distorted. The new image will also replace the {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s banner image on the {{variable.Object_Event}} landing page on a mobile device. This is especially important for {{variable.Object_Event}} s using the Dynamic UI. The Dynamic UI uses a different image ratio for banners, which results in cropped thumbnails on the {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} webpage. The logic for the {{variable.Field_EV_ThumbnailMobiImageURL}} field works as follows: If there's a value in the {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s {{variable.Field_EV_ThumbnailMobiImageURL}} field and a value in the {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_ImageURL}} field, then when an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} views an {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} , they will see the image in the {{variable.Field_EV_ThumbnailMobiImageURL}} field. If the {{variable.Field_EV_ThumbnailMobiImageURL}} field is blank, but the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_ImageURL}} field has a value, {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s will see the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_ImageURL}} when viewing the {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} . If both fields are blank, the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} will see a blank image. Available Banner and Thumbnail Fields  Banner: {{variable.Object_Event}} ’s {{variable.Field_ETEvent_ImageURL}} (Image_URL__c) and {{variable.Field_EV_ImageName}} (Image_Name__c)  Thumbnail: {{variable.Object_Event}} 's {{variable.Field_EV_ThumbnailMobiImageURL}} (Thumbnail_and_Mobile_Image_URL__c) and {{variable.Field_EV_ThumbnailImageName}} (Thumbnail_Image_Name__c) Default Event Groups When an {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record has the {{variable.Field_EVSet_DisAutoAddDefEVGrp}} field enabled (checked), then {{variable.Object_Event}} s associated with the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record but without an assigned primary {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} will not be added automatically to the {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} with {{variable.Field_ETGroup_Default}} set to “True” (checked). This change allows Event Organizers to have standalone {{variable.Object_Event}} s that aren’t assigned to an {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} , while still using the default {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} for non-standalone {{variable.Object_Event}} s. Create an Event Group Change with Event Settings Event Settings applied at the Event Group level will override all Event Settings applied at the individual Event level. Previously, Event Settings applied at the Event level overrode Event Settings applied to an Event Group. Navigate to the {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} tab and click {{variable.button_new}} to create a new {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} . Fill in the {{variable.Field_ETGroup_EventGroupName}} . Enable the {{variable.Field_ETGroup_Default}} checkbox if you want this {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} to be added to all {{variable.Object_Event}} s by default. {{variable.Field_ETGroup_PrimaryColor}} - This is a hex value and will control the colors that are displayed on the {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} . {{variable.Field_ETGroup_LogoURL}} - We support SVG files for uploading an image for {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} s. This will ensure any resolution image used will display properly on the {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} . This image will be displayed in the top-left corner of the {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} . Please see our documentation on Images for more information. {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} {{variable.Field_ETGroup_Settings}} - If you want to hide full capacity {{variable.Object_Event}} s related to the {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} , set the {{variable.Field_ETGroup_Settings}} picklist field to {{variable.Picklist_ETGroup_Hidewowaitlis}} . Use the {{variable.Field_ETGroup_UIExperience}} picklist to determine which {{glossary.user interface (UI)}} you want an end user to see. Calendar - will display a calendar view with {{variable.Object_Event}} s marked by date. List - will display a list view with {{variable.Object_Event}} s sorted by date. Aspen - will display a grid view with {{variable.Object_Event}} s that can be filtered by keywords. Maple - will display a list view with {{variable.Object_Event}} s that can be filtered by keywords. Apply custom CSS to the {{variable.Field_EVGroup_CustomCSSUrl}} field. Custom CSS is applied additively (multiple CSS files are loaded simultaneously) rather than hierarchically (one CSS file overrides another and so on). If the {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} has a CSS file in the {{variable.Field_EVGroup_CustomCSSUrl}} field AND the {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} ’s {{variable.Field_EVGroup_EventSettings}} field contains a related {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} record with a different CSS file in the {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_CustmCSSUrl}} field, then the CSS file in the related {{variable.Object_EventSettings}} {{variable.Field_ETETSettings_CustmCSSUrl}} field will be applied. If the {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} ’s {{variable.Field_EVGroup_CustomCSSUrl}} field includes code that should be applied at the {{variable.Object_Event}} -level, then the code will be applied to all the {{variable.Object_Event}} s in the {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} . For example, if the file in the {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} ’s {{variable.Field_EVGroup_CustomCSSUrl}} field includes code that will change the color of the Share button, the color will be updated for all {{variable.Object_Event}} s in the {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} . Note: Using the “!important” tag in a CSS file will overwrite all other CSS files or styling rules for that specific feature on the element. Navigate to an {{variable.Object_Event}} and define the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventGroup}} . Click the {{variable.Field_ETGroup_EventGroupURL}} and you will see all your grouped {{variable.Object_Event}} s! Featured Events If you would like a featured event at the top of the page, navigate to one of your {{variable.Object_Event}} s in the {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} and check the {{variable.Field_Event_FeaturedEvent}} field. Notice the "Free Event" is our Featured Event for this {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} ! Name, Description, and Image The following {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} fields will be pulled from the individual {{variable.Object_Event}} record. The {{variable.Field_ETGroup_EventGroupName}} will be pulled from the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventName}} field. The {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} {{variable.Field_ETGroup_Description}} will be pulled from the {{variable.Object_Event}} {{variable.Field_ETEvent_Description}} field. The Image will be pulled from the {{variable.Object_Event}} {{variable.Field_ETEvent_ImageURL}} field. Event Sorting By default, we provide different types of {{variable.Object_Event}} sorting within your {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} . Date Range This allows an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} to see upcoming {{variable.Object_Event}} s, all {{variable.Object_Event}} s, or {{variable.Object_Event}} s within a selected range of dates. Category On the {{variable.Field_ETGroup_EventGroupURL}} page, select an option from the {{variable.Field_ETGroup_Category}} drop-down field. This allows an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} to filter between categories, such as "Virtual Events", "Conference", "Class/Workshops" and more! If your {{variable.Object_Event}} s do not have a {{variable.Field_ETEvent_Category}} assigned, the picklist will not be available. Filtered Event Sorting The field {{variable.Field_ETGroup_FilterFields}} is located on the {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} record. When this field is defined, certain filters can be hidden or displayed. There are 4 options in the {{variable.Field_ETGroup_FilterFields}} picklist. {{variable.Picklist_ETGrp_FilterFlds_Cate}} When chosen, this will display the different categories that are assigned to your {{variable.Object_Event}} s. NOTE: If all {{variable.Object_Event}} s in an {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} are assigned to the same {{variable.Field_ETEvent_Category}} , this field will not appear on the {{variable.Object_Event}} page. {{variable.Picklist_ETGrp_FilterFld_Keywo}} When chosen, this will display the different {{variable.Object_EventKeyword}} s that are assigned to your {{variable.Object_Event}} s. {{variable.Picklist_ETGrp_FilterFld_NoFil}} Since the {{variable.Field_ETGroup_FilterFields}} field is a required value, pick this option if you don't want any Categories or Keywords to appear. This will also hide the {{variable.Field_ETGroup_FilterFields}} picklist from the {{variable.Object_Event}} page. {{variable.Picklist_ETGrp_FilterFld_Dista}} When customers are viewing the {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} by Distance, they will be prompted (if the request for access is enabled) to turn on their location services. {{variable.Object_Event}} s will be sorted by closest to furthest, and {{variable.Object_Event}} s within a Mileage Distance Group will be sorted by newest to oldest. Zip Code Search To search for {{variable.Object_Event}} s by zip code, enter the zip code into the main search bar. The results are based on the Venue information ( {{variable.Field_ETEvent_VenuePostalCode}} field) for the {{variable.Object_Event}} s within the {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} . Keyword Filters and Logic Use the {{variable.Field_ETGroup_CombKeyFiltLogic}} field on the {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} to designate whether keyword filters work together with AND logic or with OR logic in an {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} . Field Label: {{variable.Field_ETGroup_CombKeyFiltLogic}} API Name: conference360__Keyword_Filter_AND_Logic__c Data Type: checkbox Default: “False” or unchecked Description: This field overrides the default OR logic when multiple keywords are used to filter an Event Group. When using AND logic, selecting additional keywords generally decreases the number of visible Events. When using OR logic, selecting additional keywords generally increases the number of visible Events. Note for customers using the Aspen, List, and Calendar user interfaces (UIs). The addition of the {{variable.Field_ETGroup_CombKeyFiltLogic}} field has changed the default logic for customers using the Aspen, List, and Calendar UIs. The new default behavior combines keyword filters with “OR” logic. If you prefer to maintain the existing “AND” logic, Event Groups with affected UIs must be updated so that {{variable.Field_ETGroup_CombKeyFiltLogic}} = "True". {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s will experience one of the following scenarios depending on whether the keyword filters work together with AND logic or with OR logic in an {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} . When an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} views an {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} that has {{variable.Field_ETGroup_CombKeyFiltLogic}} = “True” (checked), then they will see the number of visible {{variable.Object_Event}} s decrease (or remain the same) after each additional keyword is selected. When an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} views an {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} that has {{variable.Field_ETGroup_CombKeyFiltLogic}} = “False” (unchecked), then they will see the number of visible {{variable.Object_Event}} s increase (or remain the same) after each additional keyword is selected.
